font.family: none rendered (vector wordmark); mood reference Noto Kufi Arabic
font.reason: The only text is a hand-drawn skeleton SVG wordmark; no font runs. Geometric monoline construction follows the calm Kufic mood of Noto Kufi Arabic.

comps.translatedSummary: Wordmark SUPERHUMAN -> «ابرانسان», redrawn as 8 continuous monoline strokes (5 connected groups + 3 dot strokes).

rtlDecisions.why: Latin skeleton glyphs replaced by Persian skeleton strokes for «ابرانسان»; same stroke weight, caps, glow.
Tracking would break joining; the word is split at natural joining breaks (ا | بر | ا | نسا | ن) and groups are set apart with wide gaps, letters stay connected inside groups.

rtlDecisions.what: Parallel sync draw (START 16, DUR 52, easeInOut, pathLength dash)
rtlDecisions.why: Core of the card: same progress for all strokes, no stagger, so nothing to mirror in order.
Persian is written right to left; baseline/bowl paths start at the right end. Alif verticals keep original bottom-to-top-like physical gesture.
Asymmetric light accent moves to left:130 with the layout.

rtlDecisions.what: Horizon band, vertical sky gradient, glow drop-shadow

rasterTextHandling: No raster assets in this demo.
concerns: Registry duration is 15 f; design is ~100 f, verified via --duration 110 stills.
Skeleton letter forms are a geometric logotype, not calligraphic naskh; ن dots drawn as short strokes. If SUPERHUMAN is a real Latin brand mark, a client may prefer to keep the Latin logo.
lessons: Letter-by-letter stroke-draw wordmarks: do not translate letters one-to-one; split into joined groups, draw each group as one continuous path and keep the large gaps between groups (spacing only at joining breaks).
Skeleton Persian teeth (س) taller than the ن tooth read as 'hmm' blobs: keep س teeth short and sharp (sawtooth), ن bowl deep enough (ry ~66) or it reads as a smile.
